datasets.evidence_level: USER_RESEARCH (ChatGPT + Gemini web search, 2026-11-14) + VERIFIED ON RECEIVED FILE (user download, ingested 2026-11-14)

methods.slope: Horn (1981), 3x3 third-order finite difference, geodesic ground spacing on the CRS ellipsoid
methods.roughness: Terrain Ruggedness Index, Riley, DeGloria & Elliot (1999): sqrt(sum over 8 neighbours of (z_n - z_0)^2), metres
methods.nodata: Windows containing NoData or the raster edge -> NaN
